# FIA Labs

> We don’t just predict outcomes. We reason them.

FIA Labs is a DBA of Federated Intel AI LLC, a privately owned company in Washington, D.C., wholly owned by Unison Pictures Pty Ltd. FederatedIntel / FIA Labs is the parent — Federated Intelligence Architecture — not an eighth app. fia-labs.com redirects to federatedintel.ai.

This is the parent lab site. Products live on their own domains. FIA Labs does not sell Lite editions, custom GPTs, affiliate products, or a $49 catalog.

## Live Pro desks (seven)

- [Legal Intel (LIA Pro)](https://legalintel.ai): governed legal and forensic reasoning. Not legal advice. Desk: https://pro.legalintel.ai
- [Medical Intel (MIA Pro)](https://medicalintel.org): medical AI research for literature, biotechnology, and the medico-legal file. Not medical advice. Does not replace clinical judgment. Desk: https://mia.medicalintel.org
- [Brandium Pro](https://brandium.pro): positioning, creative strategy, and acquisition under unit economics
- [CFO Sentinel](https://cfosentinel.pro): cash, margins, runway, and downside
- [ExecMind](https://execmind.app): structured decision support for executives
- [Aquinian Studio](https://aquinian.com): a virtual Thomistic intellect for theology, philosophy, doctrine, natural law, and cultural analysis. Studio: https://studio.aquinian.com
- [Cine-Novelist](https://cinenovelist.com): character, structure, theme, and scene — stories that can withstand revision

Human judgment remains the authority. These are specialists, not a generalist, and not substitutes for counsel, a physician, a priest, a CFO, or other licensed professionals.

## FIA Plan

FIA Plan is the house seat: $50/month, an alternative to a single-desk Operator, Counsel, or Chambers seat — not an add-on. It includes 1,000 credits per period across the suite, held in one shared FIA Tank. Extra credit packs do not expire.

Rooms stay separate. Conversations, files, matters, and memory are not shared across desks. The only cross-desk object is a user-authorised FIA Brief.

## Method

Seven specialist systems. Two engines: a generation engine proposes; a symbolic engine tests. Symbolic arbitration, sequential reasoning, and a visible distinction between evidence, inference, and gap. A conclusion that cannot be reconstructed is not ready for this kind of work.

The patented federated system — seven specialists reasoning together under arbitration — is under development.
